decision.observation: The counter card is an Arstotzkan ENTRY TICKET 'VALID ON 1982.11.26' (valid today), but Day 4's bulletin requires foreigners to hold a valid ENTRY PERMIT, not a ticket. His passport (U.F., EXP 1984.08.31) is valid but no permit was presented.
decision.hypothesis: Having only a ticket instead of the now-required entry permit fails Day-4 rules, so this foreigner should be denied.
decision.memory: Day 4: citizens → ID card; foreigners → valid ENTRY PERMIT (enter-by date must not be past). Tickets alone no longer suffice.
